questions.question: Simple interest on a given sum for 3 years at a rate of 17% per year is ₹7,140 less than the simple interest on the same sum for 5 years. Find the sum.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Simple interest for 3 years at 17% per year is ₹7,140 less than simple interest for 5 years.

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = P times (r)/(100) times t 

**Calculation:**

SI₅ yₑₐᵣₛ - SI₃ yₑₐᵣₛ = ₹7,140

⇒ P times (17)/(100) times 5 - P times (17)/(100) times 3 = 7140

⇒ P times (17)/(100) times 2 = 7140 

⇒ P times (34)/(100) = 7140 

⇒ P = (7140 times 100)/(34) 

⇒ P = 21000

**∴ The correct answer is option 3.**

questions.question: A thick cylindrical pipe of length 1.4 m open at both the ends has internal and external diameters 60 cm and 80 cm, respectively. It is to be painted from all sides. What will be the cost of painting (in ₹) if the rate of painting is ₹110 / m²? (Use pi = (22)/(7) )
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length (l) = 1.4 m

Internal diameter = 60 cm = 0.6 m

External diameter = 80 cm = 0.8 m

Rate of painting = ₹110 / m²

**Formula used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of the cylinder = 2πrh

Area of both circular ends = 2πr²

Total surface area to be painted = External CSA + Internal CSA + Area of both ends

Cost of painting = Total surface area × Rate of painting

**Calculations:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85458bd774cc1b6e50f7da47f8df595ec7b51d89ce60afc170d5f7628a75492f.png] 

External radius (R) = 0.8 / 2 = 0.4 m

Internal radius (r) = 0.6 / 2 = 0.3 m

External CSA = 2πRh

⇒ External CSA = 2 × (22/7) × 0.4 × 1.4

⇒ 3.52 m²

Internal CSA = 2πrh

⇒ Internal CSA = 2 × (22/7) × 0.3 × 1.4

⇒ 2.64 m²

Area of both ends = 2(πR² - πr²)

⇒ Area of both ends = 2 × (22/7) × (0.4² - 0.3²)

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × (0.16 - 0.09)

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × 0.07 = 0.44 m²

Total surface area = External CSA + Internal CSA + Area of both ends

⇒ Total surface area = 3.52 + 2.64 + 0.44

⇒ 6.60 m²

Cost of painting = Total surface area × Rate of painting

⇒ Cost of painting = 6.60 × 110 = ₹726

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**

questions.question: Which of the following is true about average?

options.text: The average of six consecutive even integers is an even natural number
The average of six consecutive odd integers is an odd integer.
The average of six consecutive odd integers is an even integer.
The average of six consecutive odd integers is an odd natural number.

questions.solution:
**Given:**

Six consecutive odd integers

**Formula used:**

Average of n consecutive integers = Median of the sequence

**Calculation:**

Let the six consecutive odd integers be:

a, a+2, a+4, a+6, a+8, a+10

The median of these integers (since they are in sequence) is the average of the 3rd and 4th terms:

⇒ Median = (a+4 + a+6)/2

⇒ Median = (2a + 10)/2

⇒ Median = a + 5

Since a is an odd integer, a+5 will be even.

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**

questions.question: The number of schools in a city is directly proportional to the population of the city. In 2020, there were 125 schools and the population of the city was 1,80,000. In 2023, the number of schools in the city is 180. What is the percentage increase in the population of the city from 2020 to 2023?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

In 2020, there were 125 schools and the population of the city was 1,80,000.

In 2023, the number of schools in the city is 180.

**Formula used:**

Number of schools (S) ∝ Population (P)

S = kP

Where k is the proportionality constant.

**Calculations:**

In 2020:

125 = k × 180000

⇒ k = 125 / 180000

⇒ k = 0.0006944444

In 2023:

180 = 0.0006944444 × Population

⇒ Population = 180 / 0.0006944444

⇒ Population = 259200

Percentage increase in population from 2020 to 2023:

⇒ ((259200 - 180000) / 180000) × 100

⇒ (79200 / 180000) × 100

⇒ 0.44 × 100

⇒ 44%

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**

Then the percentage increase in school is equal to the percentage increase in population.

⇒ {(180 - 125)/125}× 100 = 5500/125 = 44%

questions.question: By selling an article for ₹19, a dealer makes a profit of 25%. By how much should he increase his selling price (in ₹) so as to make a profit of 50%?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) = ₹19

Profit = 25%

**Formula used:**

Cost Price (CP) = dfrac{SP}{1 + dfrac{Profit}{100}}

New Selling Price (SP') for 50% profit = (1 + dfrac{50}{100}) times CP

Increase in Selling Price = SP' - SP

**Calculation:**

CP = dfrac{19}{1 + dfrac{25}{100}}

⇒ CP = dfrac{19}{1.25}

⇒ CP = ₹15.2

New Selling Price (SP') = (1 + dfrac{50}{100}) times 15.2 

⇒ SP' = (1 + 0.5) times 15.2

⇒ SP' = 1.5 × 15.2

⇒ SP' = ₹22.8

Increase in Selling Price = SP' - SP

⇒ Increase = 22.8 - 19

⇒ Increase = ₹3.8

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**

questions.question: If the cost price of a dozen mangoes is the same as the selling price of nine mangoes, then the percentage of loss or gain is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price of 12 mangoes (12CP) = Selling Price of 9 mangoes (9SP)

**Formula Used:**

Gain Percentage = ((SP - CP) / CP) × 100

**Calculations:**

12CP = 9SP

⇒ SP / CP = 12 / 9

⇒ SP / CP = 4 / 3

Let CP = 3, then SP = 4

Gain = SP - CP = 4 - 3 = 1

Gain % = (1 / 3) × 100

Gain % = 33.33%

**∴ The percentage of gain is 33.33%.**

questions.question: Ajit walks around a circular field at the speed of two rounds per hour, while Mohit runs around it at the speed of 10 rounds per hour. They start in the same direction from the same point at 6:30 a.m. Find the time at which they cross each other.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ajit's speed = 2 rounds/hour

Mohit's speed = 10 rounds/hour

Start time = 6:30 a.m.

**Formula Used:**

Relative speed (same direction) = Speed of faster person - Speed of slower person

Time to cross = Distance (1 round) / Relative speed

**Calculations:**

Relative speed = 10 - 2 = 8 rounds/hour

Time to cross = 1 round / 8 rounds/hour = 1/8 hour

1/8 hour = (1/8) × 60 minutes = 7.5 minutes

Crossing time = Start time + Time to cross

Crossing time = 6:30 a.m. + 7.5 minutes = 6:37:30 a.m.

**∴ They cross each other at 6:37:30 a.m.**
